signal: OpenWater previewed a new UI and AI-powered features for 2026, plus Aiden AI support, after earning G2 Leader badges

email.body1:
Joseph, saw OpenWater is rolling out a new UI and AI-powered features for 2026 after a run of G2 Leader badges.

Momentum like that opens more associations and nonprofits as prospects than the team can personally cover before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for OpenWater off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Joseph, quick follow-up for OpenWater.

New AI features usually expand the in-market list faster than headcount can keep up, and the coverage gap shows up late as a missed quarter. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings OpenWater needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Joseph, last bit of proof for OpenWater.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how OpenWater's reply rate likely compares to other vertical SaaS vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Joseph, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Shipping a new UI and AI features is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a vertical-SaaS motion? I'll tailor it to OpenWater either way.
